description_en: Queries the configuration information of a specified vSwitch by calling the DescribeVSwitchAttributes operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeVSwitchAttributes接口查询指定交换机的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vswitch-attributes --vswitch-id vsw-25naue4g0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVSwitchAttributes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to query
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC to which the route table belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
路由表所属的VPC的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without querying the vSwitch configuration. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. After the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the vSwitch configuration is queried
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会查询交换机的配置信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接查询交换机的配置信息
parameters.name: dry_run

CidrBlock.description_en: The private network address range of the vSwitch
CidrBlock.description_zh: 交换机的私网地址范围

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the vSwitch was created

EnabledIpv6.description_en:
Indicates whether the IPv6 CIDR block is enabled for the vSwitch. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: not enabled
EnabledIpv6.description_zh:
是否为交换机开启IPv6网段并配置交换机的IPv6网段。取值：
true：开启。
false：不开启

Ipv6CidrBlock.description_en: The IPv6 CIDR block of the vSwitch

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the vSwitch is the default vSwitch. Valid values:

true: The vSwitch is the default vSwitch.
false: The vSwitch is not the default vSwitch
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否是默认交换机。取值：

true：默认交换机。
false：非默认交换机

OwnerId.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the resource ownership.

<notice>This value is of the Long type. Precision loss may occur in certain programming languages. Use this value with caution.></notice>
OwnerId.description_zh:
资源归属的阿里云账号ID。

<notice>该值为 Long 类型，在某些语言中可能存在精度丢失的风险，请小心使用。></notice>

RouteTable.description_en: The route table information of the vSwitch

RouteTableId.description_en: The ID of the route table associated with the vSwitch

RouteTableType.description_en:
The type of the route table. Valid values:

System: system route table.

Custom: custom route table
RouteTableType.description_zh:
路由表类型。取值：

System：系统路由表。

Custom：自定义路由表

ShareType.description_en:
The sharing type of the vSwitch.

If the value is empty, the vSwitch is a private vSwitch.
If the value is Shared, the vSwitch is a shared vSwitch.
If the value is Sharing, the vSwitch is being shared with other accounts
ShareType.description_zh:
交换机的共享类型。

取值为空时，表示该交换机为普通交换机。
取值为Shared时，表示该交换机为共享交换机。
取值为Sharing时，表示该交换机正在被他人共享

Status.description_en:
The status of the vSwitch. Valid values:

Pending: being configured. 

Available: active
Status.description_zh:
交换机的状态，取值：

Pending：配置中。 

Available：可用

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs

ZoneId.description_en: The zone to which the vSwitch belongs
